content: Qt text effects: outline via QTextCharFormat.setTextOutline(QPen) is the single clean API for document text (verified in-repo box_item.py:552 Phase 4 Pattern 3). Glow + drop shadow have NO char-format API; production approach (BallonsTranslator TextEffectRenderer, GPL-3.0): stroke pass via setTextOutline on a cloned document (horizontal) or alpha-mask morphological dilation (vertical); shadow via rendering the silhouette (text+stroke) to a pixmap, numpy blur of the alpha channel (apply_shadow_effect with radius/strength/color/offset), composited DestinationOver behind the fill; effects cached as a background_pixmap keyed by content/style, re-rendered at higher scale for export (repaint_background(render_scale)); effect padding expands the layout rect. QGraphicsDropShadowEffect/QGraphicsBlurEffect exist but apply to whole items, work in QGraphicsScene.render, and cannot do per-style glow-without-blurring-text; they are a canvas-only fallback, not a bake path.
